narrative.details:
That's an amazing story, adventurer! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.

As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
narrative.objectives: Give Deliana your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I'm going to miss you, adventurer. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.

I hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.
narrative.requestItemsText: As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Wildheart pieces in exchange for your new Feralheart Cowl and Vest?
